suppress.notes: CVE-2026-53914 affects unsafe deserialization of Kotlin Gradle build-cache metadata. OWASP Dependency-Check 13.0.0 incorrectly assigns the generic JetBrains Kotlin CPE to kotlin-stdlib, which does not contain that build-cache implementation. This suppression is intentionally limited to the exact runtime artifact and version reported by CI. Gradle build-cache reuse is disabled in gradle.properties as the mitigation for the actual vulnerable build-tool path. Replace Kotlin 2.3.10 with Kotlin 2.4.20 stable and remove this suppression when the stable release becomes available.
